newsitem.title: UK: Japan NTT mobile phone arm to float - FT.
newsitem.headline: Japan NTT mobile phone arm to float - FT.

text.p: Japan's NTT DoCoMo, the mobile phone subsidiary of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone, will make an international sale of shares next year that will value it at $20 billion, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
The float would be the largest offering by a cellular phone operator and would make it the most highly capitalised quoted mobile phone operator in the world.
NTT DoCoMo has about 10 million cellular subscribers in Japan and is a dominant player in that country's seven billion stg ($11.4 billion) wireless communications market.
The Financial Times said DoCoMo had appointed Goldman Sachs and Japan's Yamaichi Securities to lead the planned offering, due in the second half of 1998.
